Blue Screen of Life
Skill Type:  Self Buff
Trainer:  Mage
Number of Ranks:  6
Cost to Max:  ?
Transfers a portion of Health damage to Mana

Transfers a portion of damage to health to mana at an inflated rate.
Also known as BSoL or BSOL.

This skill is very popular with mages that typically have an excess of Mana and very little Health. The advantage is that increased INT greatly increases the damage done with each spell. A mage with very high INT using BSOL will do massive damage. The drawback of course if the mage happens to run out of Mana, the BSoL collapses and damage gets applied to Health. The second drawback is the inflated rate which the damage is applied to Mana.

Cool Down: 30 seconds




X% of all Health Damage received is transfered to Mana for 180 seconds.
Damage applied to mana is inflated by an additional 50%.
